exposure: Care in a midwife-led delivery room
cohort: The study included 748 women initially admitted to the midwifery-led unit/delivery room at Hochwald Hospital, with 585 ultimately delivering in the midwife-led room.
finding: Out of 585 women who proceeded to deliver in the midwife-led room, 326 (55.7%) delivered successfully without complications.
mod_finding: The study underlines the importance of midwife-led delivery rooms as a model of care that promotes and enhances natural childbirth and can reduce unnecessary medical interventions.
